operations.description: Describe this tool: every collab/v1 operation with its argument vector, JSON input schema, and valid examples. Add one operation token as a positional argument, as in describe snapshot.publish, to describe only that operation. It reads no collaboration state, grants no operational authority, and needs no Integration Registration.

examples.description: Describe every operation this executable accepts, so an input can be shaped before it is invoked.

operations.description: Send a new collaboration message. Leading Mentions are recipients; later Mentions are Context References.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen idempotency key; repeating one replays the same message.

source.description: Authored source. It must begin with one or more @alias recipient Mentions, optionally preceded by #label workspace tokens or #all to address other workspaces.

author_kind.description: An Agent Session must send agent_session.

context.description: Optional context handoff: the routing transaction publishes this Working Context Snapshot and activates one Context Grant per recipient. Requires author_kind agent_session; each recipient's delivery envelope binds a snapshot read plus exact pinned-diff reads for diff evidence when git state is captured.

capture_git_state.description: Pin the current branch, HEAD, merge-base, and uncommitted work (tracked modifications, the index, and untracked files that are not ignored) as a git_state block on the snapshot. On by default for a context handoff; set false to skip the pin (the pin writes one ref under refs/herdr-context/). Readers page the pinned diff with the git_state selection of context.read.

checkout.description: Bind this snapshot's file and Git context to another registered worktree of this Space's repository. Capture, reads and freshness then use that checkout and never the Space's attached worktree, even when the Space changes. Omitted, the Space's attached worktree; never the command's directory. Requires a Space with an attached Git worktree.

path.description: Absolute path of the worktree root, or a symlink to it. A subdirectory, bare repository, unregistered copy or checkout of another repository is refused.

locator.description: A Worktree-relative path for file and diff, <commit>:<path> for commit, and a pane output locator for pane_output.

coordination_id.description: Opt in to an open coordination owned by this session: the lead that began it, or the session of the same address that adopted it with handoff.adopt.

expected_revision.description: Required with assignment_id; reject stale continuation decisions.

assignment_id.description: Continue this existing assignment with a new revision and the same recipient session. Requires coordination_id.

operations.description: Reply to a collaboration message. An agent-authored reply also records the Delivery Attempt's reply disposition.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen idempotency key; repeating one replays the same reply.

source.description: Authored source. It must begin with the @alias recipient Mentions of this reply.

in_reply_to.description: The message being replied to: control.message_id, never control.thread_id.

reply_all.description: Human Reply All prefill selection; the submitted source is the stored route.

author_kind.description: An Agent Session must send agent_session.

attempt_id.description: Required for an agent-authored reply: the control.attempt_id being finished.

request_context.description: Ask the disposed delivery's sender for its working context from an agent_thread or one-shot return_to_source relay. The reply transaction creates a pending Context Grant whose id is the request; the sender's envelope carries it as context_request with a pre-bound automatic fulfillment reply. Requires author_kind agent_session, and the reply must mention the sender. Cannot be combined with a context block.

decline_context_request.description: Settle a pending context request by refusal: name its control.context_request.grant_id. Only the request's exact source Agent Session may decline; the grant moves pending -> revoked.

context.description: Optional context handoff: the routing transaction publishes this Working Context Snapshot. Without grant_ids it activates one new Context Grant per recipient; with grant_ids it fulfills exactly those pending context requests instead. Requires author_kind agent_session; each grantee's delivery envelope binds a snapshot read plus exact pinned-diff reads for diff evidence when git state is captured.

grant_ids.description: Fulfill exactly these pending Context Grants (from control.context_request). Each named grant's grantee must be a recipient of this reply. Empty or absent means create-mode.

work_outcome.description: Tracked worker outcome. Missing means unclassified; never implicit success.

waiting_on_assignment_id.description: Optional blocked dependency in the same coordination; cycles are rejected.

operations.description: Transfer an open coordination from an earlier session of this same registered address to the current session, after that session was replaced in the pane. Idempotent for the same caller. Refused for another address, for the session that already owns it, for a request_id this session used for another coordination, and for a resolved coordination. Assignments and reports are unchanged; worker replies still queued for the earlier session are cancelled, and anything already dispatched or held for it stays as it is. Requires the tracked-work capability registration.

management_operations.description: Only after explicit human review and confirmation: acknowledge a historical blocked or cancelled handoff warning, the warning on an open handoff whose lead address is retired, or the warning on a completed handoff whose saved report's delivery was cancelled. Requires no unfinished linked deliveries, for blocked or cancelled outcomes a saved, settled report, and for completed outcomes a saved report whose delivery was cancelled. Preserves the outcome, report and all deliveries; does not resume work or claim completion. Outside the registered capability and automatic-permission profile.

examples.description: After the human reviews a resolved handoff and asks to clear its warning.

management_operations.description: Only after explicit human review and confirmation: cancel one held attempt or one unsent held delivery. Sent work is not retracted and the agent is not stopped. No retry is requested. Outside the registered capability and automatic-permission profile.

examples.description: After the human reviews the held attempt and confirms cancellation.
After the human reviews an unsent held delivery and confirms cancellation.

management_operations.description: Only after explicit human review and confirmation: acknowledge the missing-disposition warning on a settled delivery attempt whose recipient address is retired or whose exact session was replaced on a live name. Records the acknowledgement and clears only that warning; does not record a disposition, change the delivery, or resend anything. Refused while the recipient is not retired and no newer session has been seen on its name. Outside the registered capability and automatic-permission profile.

examples.description: After the human confirms the recipient is retired or its session was replaced, and asks to clear the missing-disposition warning.

management_operations.description: Only on an explicit user request: set or clear one agent's persona, the short description of what it specializes in. `description` is required so an edit cannot clear it by omission; null or blank text means Generic, which carries no specialization and stays eligible for ordinary work. At most 1000 characters, no control characters, and refused for a named terminal. A persona guides selection only and grants no permissions. This operation is outside the registered capability and automatic-permission profile.
